title: Revenue Recognition
description: Teaching mockup of revenue recognition for a software licence deal (IFRS 15 and ASC 606): the five steps, performance obligations, price allocation, monthly schedule, balances and journal entries, variable consideration, contract changes, contract costs, disclosures and key judgements. Fictional sample data.
insights: One contract with three kinds of software and three services: licences are recognised at one point in time, subscription and operations evenly, services by progress, usage as it arises.
Billed, recognised and collected are three numbers. At the end of December 2026: 78,800.00 billed, 96,052.64 recognised, 73,400.00 collected.
The committed price of 388,000.00 is shared out by stand-alone price; the 28,700.00 discount is spread proportionally, or lands on the licence under the residual approach.
Fictional sample data. Not accounting advice; the policy choices must be confirmed by the company's accountants.
prompt: Bundled example: Revenue Recognition for a software licence deal (static mockup, data embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
